-- Starts every service. DataService goes last so the others are listening
-- before the first profile loads.
local Services = script.Parent.Services

local ORDER = {
	"StatService",
	"TrainingService",
	"ZoneService",
	"RebirthService",
	"PunchService",
	"EggService",
	"MonetizationService",
	"LeaderboardService",
	"DataService",
}

for _, name in ORDER do
	local service = require(Services[name])
	service.Start()
end

-- Only authoring previews are removed in Play. The original six biomes stay intact.
local track=workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Track")
local preview=track:FindFirstChild("ExtensionsPreview")
if preview then
 for _,world in ipairs(preview:GetChildren()) do world:Destroy();task.wait() end
 preview:Destroy()
end
print("[TrackExtension] original biomes=6; appended landscape catalog=60; extra runtime world budget=8")

-- Ordered durable profiles with cross-server leases; Studio saves stay separate from live.
local DataStoreService=game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService=game:GetService("HttpService")
local DataService={}
local STORE_NAME=if RunService:IsStudio() then "StatSim_v1_Studio" else "StatSim_v1"
local AUTOSAVE_SECONDS,LEASE_SECONDS=45,180
local profiles,sessions,loading={},{},{}
local store,started,shuttingDown=nil,false,false
local loadedEvent=Instance.new("BindableEvent")
DataService.ProfileLoaded=loadedEvent.Event

local function defaults()
 return {SchemaVersion=2,Strength=0,TotalStrength=0,XP=0,Level=1,Rebirths=0,Coins=0,
 BestPunch=0,PetInv={},NextPetUid=1,WorldUnlocked=1,BoostEnd=0,CoinBoostEnd=0,LuckEnd=0,
 AutoTrainOn=true,AutoPunchOn=true,AutoHatchOn=true,Receipts={},ReceiptOrder={},WorldSkipCredits=0}
end
local function copy(value)
 if type(value)~="table" then return value end
 local result={}
 for k,v in value do result[k]=copy(v) end
 return result
end
local function reconcile(value)
 assert(value==nil or type(value)=="table","Stored profile is not a table")
 local data=copy(value or {})
 for k,v in defaults() do
  if type(data[k])~=type(v) then data[k]=copy(v) end
  if type(v)=="number" and (data[k]~=data[k] or math.abs(data[k])==math.huge or data[k]<v) then data[k]=v end
 end
 data.SchemaVersion=2
 data._Session=nil
 return data
end
local function retries(fn)
 local err
 for attempt=1,3 do
  local ok,result=pcall(fn)
  if ok then return true,result end
  err=result
  if attempt<3 then task.wait(attempt) end
 end
 return false,err
end
local function key(player) return "player_"..player.UserId end
local function status(player,text,persistent)
 player:SetAttribute("DataStatus",text)
 player:SetAttribute("DataPersistent",persistent)
end
function DataService.Load(player)
 if loading[player] or sessions[player] or shuttingDown then return end
 loading[player]=true
 status(player,"Loading",false)
 local token=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
 local data,err,ok,locked
 for attempt=1,5 do
  locked=false
  ok,err=retries(function()
   assert(store,"Data store unavailable")
   return store:UpdateAsync(key(player),function(old)
    local lease=type(old)=="table" and old._Session
    if lease and lease.Id~=token and type(lease.ExpiresAt)=="number" and lease.ExpiresAt>os.time() then
     locked=true
     return nil
    end
    local nextData=reconcile(old)
    nextData._Session={Id=token,ExpiresAt=os.time()+LEASE_SECONDS}
    return nextData
   end)
  end)
  if ok and err then data=err;break end
  if not locked or attempt==5 or not player.Parent then break end
  task.wait(2)
 end
 loading[player]=nil
 if data then
  profiles[player]=reconcile(data)
  sessions[player]={Token=token,Persistent=true,Busy=false,Closing=false}
  status(player,"Saved",true)
  player:SetAttribute("LastSaveAt",os.time())
 elseif RunService:IsStudio() and not locked then
  -- Explicit preview only: never acknowledges a purchase or writes defaults over real data.
  profiles[player]=defaults()
  sessions[player]={Persistent=false,Busy=false,Closing=false}
  status(player,"Session only - enable Studio API access",false)
  warn("[DataService] Studio data access unavailable; progress is session-only. "..tostring(err))
 else
  status(player,"Load failed",false)
  player:Kick(if locked then "Your previous server is still saving. Please rejoin in a moment." else "Saved progress could not be loaded. Please rejoin; your existing data has not been replaced.")
  return
 end
 if not player.Parent or shuttingDown then
  DataService.Save(player,true)
  profiles[player],sessions[player]=nil,nil
  return
 end
 loadedEvent:Fire(player,profiles[player])
end
function DataService.Get(player)
 local session=sessions[player]
 return if session and not session.Closing then profiles[player] else nil
end
function DataService.Save(player,release)
 local session=sessions[player]
 if not session or not profiles[player] or not session.Persistent then return false end
 if release then session.Closing=true end
 -- Snapshot is taken after waiting: stale autosaves cannot overwrite newer purchases.
 while session.Busy do task.wait() end
 if session.Released then return session.LastResult==true end
 session.Busy=true
 local snapshot=copy(profiles[player])
 snapshot.SavedAt=os.time()
 snapshot._Session=if release then nil else {Id=session.Token,ExpiresAt=os.time()+LEASE_SECONDS}
 status(player,"Saving",true)
 local lost=false
 local ok,result=retries(function()
  return store:UpdateAsync(key(player),function(old)
   if type(old)~="table" or type(old._Session)~="table" or old._Session.Id~=session.Token then
    lost=true
    return nil
   end
   return snapshot
  end)
 end)
 local saved=ok and result~=nil and not lost
 session.LastResult=saved
 if release and saved then session.Released=true end
 session.Busy=false
 if saved then
  player:SetAttribute("LastSaveAt",snapshot.SavedAt)
  status(player,"Saved",true)
 else
  status(player,"Save retry pending",not lost)
  warn("[DataService] Save failed for "..player.UserId..": "..tostring(result))
  if lost and player.Parent then player:Kick("Your data session moved to another server. Please rejoin to reload your latest progress.") end
 end
 return saved
end
function DataService.HasReceipt(profile,purchaseId) return profile.Receipts[tostring(purchaseId)]==true end
function DataService.AddReceipt(profile,purchaseId)
 -- Keep the receipt ledger; pruning old IDs can award a retried receipt twice.
 local id=tostring(purchaseId)
 if profile.Receipts[id] then return end
 profile.Receipts[id]=true
 table.insert(profile.ReceiptOrder,id)
end
function DataService.Start()
 if started then return end
 started=true
 local ok,result=pcall(function() return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME) end)
 if ok then store=result end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(DataService.Load)
 for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(DataService.Load,player) end
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
  DataService.Save(player,true)
  profiles[player],sessions[player]=nil,nil
 end)
 game:BindToClose(function()
  shuttingDown=true
  local pending=0
  for player in profiles do
   pending+=1
   task.spawn(function() DataService.Save(player,true);pending-=1 end)
  end
  local deadline=os.clock()+26
  while pending>0 and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait() end
 end)
 task.spawn(function()
  while not shuttingDown do
   task.wait(AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
   for player,session in sessions do
    if not session.Closing then task.spawn(DataService.Save,player) end
   end
  end
 end)
end
return DataService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local RebirthConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Rebirth)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)

local RebirthService = {}

-- reset = false is the paid Rebirth Skip (keeps Strength and level)
function RebirthService.DoRebirth(player, reset)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return false
	end
	profile.Rebirths += 1
	if reset then
		profile.Strength = 0
		profile.XP = 0
		profile.Level = 1
	end
	StatService.Refresh(player)
	Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Rebirth " .. profile.Rebirths .. "! Gains are now x" .. RebirthConfig.Multiplier(profile.Rebirths))
	return true
end

local function onRebirth(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	local need = RebirthConfig.LevelRequired(profile.Rebirths)
	if profile.Level < need then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Reach Level " .. need .. " to rebirth")
		return
	end
	RebirthService.DoRebirth(player, true)
end

function RebirthService.Start()
	Remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(onRebirth)
end

return RebirthService

-- Global top 10 by lifetime Strength on the board in Workspace.Map.Leaderboard.
-- Falls back to players in this server if the OrderedDataStore is not available.
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Format)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local LeaderboardService = {}

local REFRESH_SECONDS = 60
local TOP = 10
local names = {}

local function nameFor(userId)
	if names[userId] then
		return names[userId]
	end
	local ok, name = pcall(Players.GetNameFromUserIdAsync, Players, userId)
	names[userId] = if ok then name else "Player"
	return names[userId]
end

local function getList()
	local board = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") and workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("Leaderboard")
	local gui = board and board:FindFirstChild("Board") and board.Board:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
	return gui and gui:FindFirstChild("List")
end

local function render(rows)
	local list = getList()
	if not list then
		return
	end
	for _, child in list:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for rank, row in rows do
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "Row" .. rank
		label.LayoutOrder = rank
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.085, 0)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.TextColor3 = if rank == 1 then Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60) elseif rank <= 3 then Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255) else Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		label.Text = "#" .. rank .. "  " .. row.Name .. "  " .. Format.Number(row.Value)
		label.Parent = list
	end
end

local function serverRows()
	local rows = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		if profile then
			table.insert(rows, {Name = player.Name, Value = profile.TotalStrength})
		end
	end
	table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
		return a.Value > b.Value
	end)
	while #rows > TOP do
		table.remove(rows)
	end
	return rows
end

local function refresh(store)
	if store then
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local profile = DataService.Get(player)
			if profile then
				pcall(store.SetAsync, store, tostring(player.UserId), math.floor(profile.TotalStrength))
			end
		end
		local ok, pages = pcall(store.GetSortedAsync, store, false, TOP)
		if ok then
			local rows = {}
			for _, entry in pages:GetCurrentPage() do
				table.insert(rows, {Name = nameFor(tonumber(entry.key)), Value = entry.value})
			end
			render(rows)
			return
		end
	end
	render(serverRows())
end

function LeaderboardService.Start()
	local ok, store = pcall(DataStoreService.GetOrderedDataStore, DataStoreService, "TopStrength_v1")
	if not ok then
		store = nil
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(5)
		while true do
			refresh(store)
			task.wait(REFRESH_SECONDS)
		end
	end)
end

return LeaderboardService

-- Free Strength every second for everyone, clicks on top (rate limited),
-- extra auto clicks for Auto Click owners. Popups are drawn by the client.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local StatsConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Stats)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)

local TrainingService = {}

local clickWindows = {}

local function isAlive(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function onTrain(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local window = clickWindows[player]
	if not window or now - window.Start >= 1 then
		window = {Start = now, Count = 0}
		clickWindows[player] = window
	end
	window.Count += 1
	if window.Count > StatsConfig.MaxClicksPerSecond then
		return
	end
	if not DataService.Get(player) or not isAlive(player) then
		return
	end
	StatService.AddStrength(player, StatService.Gain(player) * StatsConfig.ClickValue)
end

local function toggler(field)
	return function(player, on)
		if typeof(on) ~= "boolean" then
			return
		end
		local profile = DataService.Get(player)
		if not profile then
			return
		end
		profile[field] = on
		StatService.Refresh(player)
	end
end

function TrainingService.Start()
	Remotes.Train.OnServerEvent:Connect(onTrain)
	Remotes.ToggleAutoTrain.OnServerEvent:Connect(toggler("AutoTrainOn"))
	Remotes.ToggleAutoPunch.OnServerEvent:Connect(toggler("AutoPunchOn"))
	Remotes.ToggleAutoHatch.OnServerEvent:Connect(toggler("AutoHatchOn"))
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		clickWindows[player] = nil
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(StatsConfig.TickSeconds)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				local profile = DataService.Get(player)
				if profile and isAlive(player) then
					local clicks = StatsConfig.PassiveClicks
					if profile.AutoTrainOn and StatService.OwnsPass(player, "AutoTrain") then
						clicks += StatsConfig.AutoClicks
					end
					StatService.AddStrength(player, StatService.Gain(player) * clicks)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return TrainingService

-- Where is each player: which world (by distance to world centers) and which
-- gym pad. Portals teleport (server checks Strength). Gym pads with a pass
-- lock get a buy prompt.
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config
local Zones = require(Config.Zones)
local Gym = require(Config.Gym)
local Monetization = require(Config.Monetization)
local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Format)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)

local ZoneService = {}

local CHECK_SECONDS = 0.25
local lastAllowed = {}
local lastTeleport = {}
local gymPads = {}

local function gameplay()
	return workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Gameplay")
end

local function worldAt(position)
	for i = #Zones.List, 2, -1 do
		local c = Zones.List[i].Center
		if (Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z) - Vector3.new(c.X, 0, c.Z)).Magnitude < Zones.Radius then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 1
end

local function gymAt(position)
	for tier, pad in gymPads do
		local rel = pad.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if math.abs(rel.X) <= pad.Size.X / 2 + 1 and math.abs(rel.Z) <= pad.Size.Z / 2 + 1 and rel.Y < 12 and rel.Y > -2 then
			return tier
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function hubSpawn()
	local spawnPart = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
	return if spawnPart then spawnPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) else CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
end

local function teleportTo(player, world)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	if world == 1 then
		character:PivotTo(hubSpawn())
		return
	end
	local folder = gameplay().Worlds:FindFirstChild("World" .. world)
	local spawnPart = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("WorldSpawn")
	if spawnPart then
		character:PivotTo(spawnPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	end
end

local function tryTeleport(player, world)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile or not Zones.List[world] then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastTeleport[player] and now - lastTeleport[player] < 2 then
		return
	end
	if world > StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) then
		lastTeleport[player] = now
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Need " .. Format.Number(Zones.List[world].Required) .. " Strength for " .. Zones.List[world].Name .. " World")
		return
	end
	lastTeleport[player] = now
	teleportTo(player, world)
	Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Welcome to " .. Zones.List[world].Name .. " World! x" .. Zones.List[world].Multiplier .. " Strength here")
end

local function label(parent, text, offset)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "Label"
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 90)
	bb.StudsOffset = offset
	bb.MaxDistance = 140
	bb.LightInfluence = 0
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.RichText = true
	t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	t.Text = text
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Thickness = 3
	s.Parent = t
	t.Parent = bb
	bb.Parent = parent
	return t
end

local function promptPass(player, passKey)
	local pass = Monetization.Passes[passKey]
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, passKey) then
		return
	end
	if pass.Id==0 then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player,pass.Name.." is not listed yet")
		return
	end
	MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, pass.Id)
end

local function setupPortals()
	for _, pad in gameplay().Portals:GetChildren() do
		local world = pad:GetAttribute("World")
		local info = Zones.List[world]
		label(pad, string.format("%s WORLD\n<font size=\"22\">Need %s Strength \u{2022} x%d</font>", string.upper(info.Name), Format.Number(info.Required), info.Multiplier), Vector3.new(0, 9, 0))
		pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			if player then
				tryTeleport(player, world)
			end
		end)
	end
	for _, folder in gameplay().Worlds:GetChildren() do
		local back = folder:FindFirstChild("ReturnPortal")
		if back then
			label(back, "BACK TO HUB", Vector3.new(0, 8, 0))
			back.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if player then
					tryTeleport(player, 1)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function setupGym()
	for _, pad in gameplay().GymPads:GetChildren() do
		local tier = pad:GetAttribute("Tier")
		local info = Gym.Tiers[tier]
		if info then
			gymPads[tier] = pad
			local need = if info.Pass then Monetization.Passes[info.Pass].Name else (if (info.Rebirths or 0) > 0 then info.Rebirths .. " Rebirths" else "FREE")
			label(pad, string.format("%s\n<font color=\"#9BFF8A\">x%d STRENGTH</font>\n<font size=\"20\">%s</font>", string.upper(info.Name), info.Multiplier, need), Vector3.new(0, 8, 0))
			if info.Pass then
				local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
				prompt.Name = "BuyPrompt"
				prompt.ActionText = "Unlock " .. info.Name
				prompt.ObjectText = "x" .. info.Multiplier .. " Strength"
				prompt.HoldDuration = 0
				prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
				prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
				prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.F
				prompt.Parent = pad
				prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
					promptPass(player, info.Pass)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function check(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not profile or not root then
		return
	end
	local allowed = StatService.AllowedWorld(profile)
	if lastAllowed[player] and allowed > lastAllowed[player] then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, Zones.List[allowed].Name .. " World unlocked! Take the portal in the hub")
	end
	lastAllowed[player] = allowed

	local world = worldAt(root.Position)
	if world > allowed then
		teleportTo(player, 1)
		world = 1
	end
	local gymTier = if world == 1 then gymAt(root.Position) else nil
	if gymTier and not StatService.GymUnlocked(player, gymTier) then
		gymTier = nil
	end
	StatService.SetLocation(player, world, gymTier)
end

function ZoneService.Start()
	setupPortals()
	setupGym()
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastAllowed[player] = nil
		lastTeleport[player] = nil
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(CHECK_SECONDS)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				check(player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return ZoneService

-- Punch the dummy (ProximityPrompt + Auto Punch pass). The server decides the
-- feet, the Coins and where on the track it lands; clients only animate it.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config
local PunchConfig = require(Config.Punch)
local Zones = require(Config.Zones)
local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Format)
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local StatService = require(script.Parent.StatService)

local PunchService = {}

local lastPunch = {}
local dummy = nil

-- Coins one punch would give right now (also used by Coin products)
function PunchService.CoinsPerPunch(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return 0
	end
	local feet = PunchConfig.Feet(profile.Strength)
	local world = Zones.List[StatService.AllowedWorld(profile)]
	return PunchConfig.Coins(feet, world.Multiplier, StatService.CoinMultiplier(player)), feet
end

local function punch(player, isAuto)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastPunch[player] and now - lastPunch[player] < PunchConfig.Cooldown then
		return
	end
	lastPunch[player] = now

	local coins, feet = PunchService.CoinsPerPunch(player)
	StatService.AddCoins(player, coins)
	if feet > profile.BestPunch then
		profile.BestPunch = feet
		StatService.Refresh(player)
		if not isAuto then
			Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "NEW BEST: " .. Format.Number(feet) .. " FT!")
		end
	end
	Remotes.PunchFx:FireAllClients(player, feet, coins, PunchConfig.TrackX(feet), isAuto)
end

local function onPrompt(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not dummy then
		return
	end
	local reach = PunchConfig.MaxRange * character:GetScale()
	if (root.Position - dummy:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude > reach then
		return
	end
	punch(player, false)
end

function PunchService.Start()
	dummy = workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Gameplay"):WaitForChild("PunchLane"):WaitForChild("Dummy")
	dummy.PrimaryPart:WaitForChild("PunchPrompt").Triggered:Connect(onPrompt)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastPunch[player] = nil
	end)

	-- Auto Punch pass: punches for you anywhere until you turn it off
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(PunchConfig.AutoInterval)

local receiptBusy={}
local function processReceiptUnlocked(info)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(info.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	if not profile then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	-- Already granted earlier: only confirm once it is saved
	if DataService.HasReceipt(profile, info.PurchaseId) then
		if DataService.Save(player) then
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local productKey, product = Monetization.FindProduct(info.ProductId)
	if not productKey or not grants[productKey] then
		warn("[Monetization] Unknown product " .. tostring(info.ProductId))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local ok, granted = pcall(grants[productKey], player, product)
	if not ok or granted == false then
		warn("[Monetization] Grant deferred: " .. tostring(granted))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	DataService.AddReceipt(profile, info.PurchaseId)
	Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Thanks! " .. product.Name .. " received")

	if DataService.Save(player) then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end

local function processReceipt(info)
	local id=tostring(info.PlayerId)
	while receiptBusy[id] do task.wait() end
	receiptBusy[id]=true
	local ok,result=pcall(processReceiptUnlocked,info)
	receiptBusy[id]=nil
	if not ok then warn("[Monetization] Receipt deferred: "..tostring(result));return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet end
	return result
end

-- Ownership check with retries so a Roblox hiccup on join doesn't hide a pass
local function ownsPass(player, passId)
	for attempt = 1, 3 do
		local ok, owns = pcall(MarketplaceService.UserOwnsGamePassAsync, MarketplaceService, player.UserId, passId)
		if ok then
			return owns
		end
		if not player.Parent then
			return false
		end
		task.wait(attempt)
	end
	warn("[Monetization] Could not check pass " .. passId .. " for " .. player.UserId)
	return false
end

local function checkPasses(player)
	for passKey, pass in Monetization.Passes do
		if pass.Id ~= 0 then
			task.spawn(function()
				if ownsPass(player, pass.Id) and player.Parent then
					StatService.SetPass(player, passKey, true)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function MonetizationService.Start()
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = processReceipt
	DataService.ProfileLoaded:Connect(checkPasses)

	-- Fired by Roblox on the server, so the client cannot fake it
	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		if not purchased or passId == 0 then
			return
		end
		for passKey, pass in Monetization.Passes do
			if pass.Id == passId then
				StatService.SetPass(player, passKey, true)
				Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Thanks! " .. pass.Name .. " unlocked")
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Highest world the player may enter (Strength or the World Skip product)
function StatService.AllowedWorld(profile)
	local allowed = 1
	for i, world in Zones.List do
		if profile.Strength >= world.Required then
			allowed = i
		end
	end
	return math.max(allowed, math.min(profile.WorldUnlocked or 1, #Zones.List))

function StatService.GymUnlocked(player, tier)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local info = Gym.Tiers[tier]

	end

	end

	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local world = Zones.List[currentWorld[player] or 1]
	local gymTier = currentGym[player]
	local gamepass = 1
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "Double") then

	end
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "VIP") then
		gamepass *= 1.5
	end
	return {
		World = world.Multiplier,
		Gym = if gymTier then Gym.Tiers[gymTier].Multiplier else 1,
		Rebirth = if profile then RebirthConfig.Multiplier(profile.Rebirths) else 1,
		Gamepass = gamepass,
		Pets = if profile then PetsConfig.Multiplier(StatService.EquippedIds(profile)) else 1,
		Boost = if profile and profile.BoostEnd > os.time() then 2 else 1,
	}
end

function StatService.Gain(player)
	local total = StatsConfig.BaseGain
	for _, value in StatService.Multipliers(player) do

	end

end

function StatService.CoinMultiplier(player)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local m = 1
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "DoubleCoins") then
		m *= 2
	end
	if StatService.OwnsPass(player, "VIP") then
		m *= 1.5
	end
	if profile and profile.CoinBoostEnd > os.time() then
		m *= 2
	end
	return m

	local profile = DataService.Get(player)

	local mults = StatService.Multipliers(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Strength", profile.Strength)
	player:SetAttribute("XP", profile.XP)
	player:SetAttribute("XPNeeded", StatsConfig.XpForLevel(profile.Level))

		player:SetAttribute("Mult_" .. name, value)
	end

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats then
		stats.Strength.Value = math.min(math.floor(profile.Strength), 2 ^ 53)
		stats.Coins.Value = math.min(math.floor(profile.Coins), 2 ^ 53)
		stats.Rebirths.Value = profile.Rebirths

	end

	local profile = DataService.Get(player)

	local sorted = table.clone(profile.PetInv)
	table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
		return power(a.p) > power(b.p)
	end)
	local slots = StatService.PetSlots(player)
	for _, entry in profile.PetInv do

	for _, entry in profile.PetInv do
		if entry.u == uid then
			target = entry
		end
		if entry.e then

		end

	if not target or target.e == equip then

-- free = true for the paid Mega Egg (already paid in Robux)
function EggService.Hatch(player, eggId, count, isAuto, free)
	local profile = DataService.Get(player)
	local egg = Eggs.List[eggId]
	if not profile or not egg then
		return false
	end
	if egg.World > StatService.AllowedWorld(profile) then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Unlock " .. Zones.List[egg.World].Name .. " World first")
		return false
	end
	if #profile.PetInv + count > PetsConfig.MaxInventory and not free then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Pet inventory full (" .. PetsConfig.MaxInventory .. ")")
		return false
	end
	-- Paid eggs must only be hatched after a processed receipt.
	if egg.ProductKey and not free then
		return false
	end
	if not free then
		local cost = egg.Cost * count
		if profile.Coins < cost then
			if not isAuto then
				Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, "Need " .. Format.Number(cost) .. " Coins. Punch the dummy!")
			end
			return false
		end
		profile.Coins -= cost
	end
	local lucky = StatService.IsLucky(player)
	local hatched = {}
	for _ = 1, count do
		local id = Eggs.Roll(eggId, lucky, rng)
		table.insert(profile.PetInv, {u = tostring(profile.NextPetUid), p = id, e = false})
		profile.NextPetUid += 1
		table.insert(hatched, id)
	end
	EggService.EquipBest(player)
	Remotes.HatchFx:FireClient(player, eggId, hatched, isAuto)
	for _, id in hatched do
		local rarity = PetsConfig.List[id].Rarity
		if rarity == "Legendary" or rarity == "Mythic" then
			for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
				Remotes.Notify:FireClient(other, player.DisplayName .. " hatched a " .. string.upper(rarity) .. " " .. PetsConfig.List[id].Name .. "!")
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function tryHatch(player, eggId, count)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastHatch[player] and now - lastHatch[player] < HATCH_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastHatch[player] = now
	local requestedEgg = Eggs.List[eggId]
	if not requestedEgg or requestedEgg.ProductKey then
		return
	end
	if count>1 and not StatService.OwnsPass(player,"TripleHatch") then
		Remotes.Notify:FireClient(player,"Triple Hatch pass required; choose Hatch 1 or open the shop")
		return
	end
	EggService.Hatch(player, eggId, count, false, false)

local function nearestStand(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	local best, bestDist = nil, AUTO_RANGE
	for stand, eggId in stands do
		if not Eggs.List[eggId].ProductKey then
			local d = (stand.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
			if d < bestDist then
				best, bestDist = eggId, d
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- Lucky (pass or boost) doubles Epic and better, taken evenly from the rest
function Eggs.Roll(eggId, lucky, rng)
	local e = Eggs.List[eggId]
	local weights = {}
	local total = 0
	for i, entry in e.Pets do
		local w = entry.Chance
		if lucky and i >= 4 and #e.Pets == 6 then
			w *= 2
		end
		weights[i] = w
		total += w
	end
	local roll = rng:NextNumber() * total
	for i, entry in e.Pets do
		roll -= weights[i]
		if roll <= 0 then
			return entry.Id
		end
	end
	return e.Pets[1].Id
end

function Punch.Progress(feet)
 assert(type(feet)=="number" and feet==feet and feet>=0 and feet<math.huge,"Invalid feet")

 if log<=7 then return math.max(0,log-1) end
 return 6+(log-7)*10
end

end

end

 return if progress<=6 then 10^(1+progress) else 10^(7+(progress-6)/10)
end

end

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Purchase = {}
local listingCache = {}

local function listing(kind, item)
    if item.Id == 0 then return false, "Listing not set up" end
    local infoType = if kind == "Pass" then Enum.InfoType.GamePass else Enum.InfoType.Product
    local ok, info = pcall(MarketplaceService.GetProductInfo, MarketplaceService, item.Id, infoType)
    if not ok or not info then return false, "Roblox price unavailable; try again" end
    local actual = info.PriceInRobux
    if type(actual) ~= "number" or actual > Monetization.MaxRobux or actual ~= item.Price then
        return false, "Listing price does not match the shop"
    end
    if info.IsForSale == false then return false, "Item is not on sale" end
    return true
end

function Purchase.Pass(key)
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local item = Monetization.Passes[key]
    if not item then return false, "Unknown pass" end
    if player:GetAttribute("Pass_" .. key) then return false, "Already owned" end
    local ok, reason = listing("Pass", item)
    if not ok then return false, reason end
    local prompted,err=pcall(MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchase,MarketplaceService,player,item.Id)
    if not prompted then return false,"Roblox purchase prompt unavailable; try again" end
    return true
end

function Purchase.Product(key)
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local item = Monetization.Products[key]
    if not item then return false, "Unknown product" end
    if not player:GetAttribute("Loaded") then return false,"Progress is still loading" end
    if not player:GetAttribute("DataPersistent") then return false,"Purchases wait until progress saving is available" end
    if key == "WorldSkip" and (player:GetAttribute("AllowedZone") or 1) >= #Zones.List then
        return false, "All current worlds already unlocked"
    end
    if key == "MegaEgg" or key == "UltraEgg" then
        local ok, policy = pcall(PolicyService.GetPolicyInfoForPlayerAsync, PolicyService, player)
        if not ok or policy.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted then
            return false, "Paid random eggs are unavailable for this player"
        end
    end
    local ok, reason = listing("Product", item)
    if not ok then return false, reason end
    local prompted,err=pcall(MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchase,MarketplaceService,player,item.Id)
    if not prompted then return false,"Roblox purchase prompt unavailable; try again" end
    return true
end

function Purchase.PriceText(kind, key)
    local item = if kind == "Pass" then Monetization.Passes[key] else Monetization.Products[key]
    if not item then return "UNAVAILABLE" end
    if item.Id == 0 then return "COMING SOON" end
    local cacheKey = kind .. tostring(item.Id)
    local cached = listingCache[cacheKey]
    if not cached or os.clock() - cached.time > 60 then
        local ok, reason = listing(kind, item)
        cached = {time = os.clock(), ok = ok, reason = reason}
        listingCache[cacheKey] = cached
    end
    return if cached.ok then "R$" .. item.Price else "UNAVAILABLE"
end

return Purchase

-- 1234 -> 1.2K, 5600000 -> 5.6M
local Format = {}

local SUFFIXES = {"", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi", "Sx", "Sp", "Oc", "No", "Dc"}

function Format.Number(n)
	n = math.floor(n)
	if n < 1000 then
		return tostring(n)
	end
	local i = 1
	local v = n
	while v >= 1000 and i < #SUFFIXES do
		v /= 1000
		i += 1
	end
	if v >= 100 then
		return math.floor(v) .. SUFFIXES[i]
	end
	local s = string.format("%.1f", math.floor(v * 10) / 10)
	s = string.gsub(s, "%.0$", "")
	return s .. SUFFIXES[i]
end

function Format.Multiplier(m)
	local s = string.format("%.2f", m)
	s = string.gsub(s, "0+$", "")
	s = string.gsub(s, "%.$", "")
	return "x" .. s
end

return Format

local function addStuds(parent: GuiObject, color: Color3, transparency: number, zIndex: number, inset: number): Frame
	local holder = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Studs",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inset, inset),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 1, -inset * 2),
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = zIndex,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	new("UIGridLayout", {
		CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(STUD, STUD),
		CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(STUD_GAP, STUD_GAP),
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	local count = 0
	local function fill()
		local size = holder.AbsoluteSize
		local cell = STUD + STUD_GAP
		local want = math.min(MAX_STUDS, math.ceil(size.X / cell) * math.ceil(size.Y / cell))
		while count < want do
			count += 1
			new("Frame", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				ZIndex = zIndex,
				Parent = holder,
			}, { corner(3), stroke(1.5, color, transparency) })
		end
	end
	holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fill)
	task.defer(fill)
	return holder
end

-- Big chunky button. Stable children for other code: Label (TextLabel), Badge (Frame, hidden), Icon (when given)
function UiStyle.Button(props: { [string]: any }): TextButton
	local color: Color3 = props.Color or UiStyle.Colors.Blue
	local shape = props.Shape or "Wide"
	local z = props.ZIndex or 2
	local radius = props.CornerRadius or (if shape == "Square" then 12 else 8)

	local button = new("TextButton", {
		Name = props.Name or "Button",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or (if shape == "Square" then UDim2.fromOffset(96, 96) else UDim2.fromOffset(200, 56)),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		ZIndex = z,
	})
	local scale = new("UIScale", { Name = "Scale", Parent = button })

	-- Lip: darker copy of the fill under the face, carries the outer outline
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Lip",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = if props.Rainbow then Color3.fromRGB(90, 40, 140) else darken(color, 0.45),
		ZIndex = z,
		Parent = button,
	}, { corner(radius), stroke(OUTLINE) })

	local face = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Face",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -LIP),
		BackgroundColor3 = if props.Rainbow then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else color,
		ZIndex = z + 1,
		Parent = button,
	}, { corner(radius) })
	if props.Rainbow then
		new("UIGradient", { Color = RAINBOW, Rotation = -30, Parent = face })
	end

	if props.Studs ~= false then
		addStuds(face, darken(color, 0.5), 0.55, z + 2, math.floor(radius / 2))
	end

	-- Shade: bottom of the face gets darker
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Shade",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		ZIndex = z + 3,
		Parent = face,
	}, {
		corner(radius),
		new("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.72),
			}),
		}),
	})

	-- Gloss: soft white band on the top half
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Gloss",
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.45, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		ZIndex = z + 4,
		Parent = face,
	}, {
		corner(math.max(radius - 3, 2)),
		new("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.92),
			}),
		}),
	})

	local dim = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Dim",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ZIndex = z + 5,
		Parent = face,
	}, { corner(radius) })

	local label = UiStyle.Label({
		Text = props.Text or "",
		ZIndex = z + 7,
		MaxTextSize = props.MaxTextSize,
		StrokeThickness = props.StrokeThickness or 3,
	})

	if props.Logo or (props.Icon ~= nil and props.Icon ~= "") then
		local icon = if props.Logo then UiStyle.Logo({Key=props.Logo, Color=color, ZIndex=z+6}) else makeIcon(props.Icon, z + 6)
		if shape == "Square" then
			-- big icon fills the top and pokes past the edge like the reference
			icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, -0.08)
			icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.78)
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -LIP - 2)
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.3)
		else
			-- icon hangs off the left edge, label fills the rest
			icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, -10, 0.5, -LIP / 2)
			icon.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY
			icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.1, 1.1)
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			label.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, -LIP / 2)
			label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, -8, 0.72, 0)
		end
		icon.Parent = button
	else
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -LIP / 2)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.72, 0)
	end
	label.Parent = button

	local badge = makeBadge(z + 8)
	badge.Visible = props.Badge == true
	badge.Parent = button

	-- Hover / press feel: scale bump, face sinks into the lip, darkens
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local hovering = false
	local function setState(state: string)
		local s = if state == "press" then 0.93 elseif state == "hover" then 1.06 else 1
		local d = if state == "press" then 0.75 elseif state == "hover" then 0.92 else 1
		local y = if state == "press" then LIP - 1 else 0
		TweenService:Create(scale, info, { Scale = s }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(dim, info, { BackgroundTransparency = d }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(face, info, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y) }):Play()
	end
	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		hovering = true
		setState("hover")
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		hovering = false
		setState("idle")
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		setState("press")
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		setState(if hovering then "hover" else "idle")
	end)

	if props.Parent then
		button.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return button
end

		toast:Destroy()

	local saveStatus=attr("DataStatus","Loading")

local function passivePerSecond()
	local clicks = StatsConfig.PassiveClicks
	if attr("Pass_AutoTrain", false) and attr("AutoTrainOn", true) then
		clicks += StatsConfig.AutoClicks
	end
	return attr("Gain", 1) * clicks
end

function HudController.Start()
	buildHud()
	shownStrength = attr("Strength", 0)
	player.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(name)
		if name ~= "Strength" then
			refresh()
		end
	end)
	refresh()
	Remotes.Notify.OnClientEvent:Connect(notify)

	-- smooth counter: always creeping toward the real (server) value
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		local target = attr("Strength", 0)
		if target < shownStrength then
			shownStrength = target
		else
			shownStrength += (target - shownStrength) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
		end
		ui.StrengthText.Text = "STRENGTH  " .. Format.Number(shownStrength) .. "   +" .. Format.Number(passivePerSecond()) .. "/sec"
	end)

	-- the illusion: a +gain popup every 0.1s
	task.spawn(function()
		local step = 1 / StatsConfig.PassiveClicks
		while true do
			task.wait(step)
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if attr("Loaded", false) and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				popup("+" .. Format.Number(passivePerSecond() * step), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), false)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- click or tap anywhere in the world to train
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			train()
		end
	end)

	-- live boost timer
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			if timeLeft("BoostEnd") > -2 then
				refresh()
			end
		end
	end)
end

return HudController

-- Flies the dummy from its stand to trackX. onStep(position) runs every frame.
local function fly(dummy, feet, trackX, onStep)
	flying = true
	TrackExtension.Prepare(trackX)
	local ghost = makeGhost(dummy)
	setVisible(dummy, false)
	local start = dummy:GetPivot()
	local decades = math.clamp(math.log10(math.max(feet, 10)) - 1, 0, 6)
	local duration = 1.6 + decades * 0.55
	local travel = trackX - start.Position.X
	local peak = math.clamp(18 + decades * 8, 18, 64)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local done = false
	local connection
	connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local a = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / duration, 0, 1)
		-- fast launch, slows down near the end
		local eased = 1 - (1 - a) ^ 2
		local pos = start.Position + Vector3.new(travel * eased, 4 * peak * a * (1 - a), 0)
		ghost:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos) * start.Rotation * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -a * math.pi * 10))
		TrackExtension.Focus(pos.X)
		if onStep then
			onStep(pos, a)
		end
		if a >= 1 then
			connection:Disconnect()
			done = true
		end
	end)
	while not done do
		task.wait()
	end
	return ghost, function()
		ghost:Destroy()
		setVisible(dummy, true)
		flying = false
		TrackExtension.Release()
	end
end

local function cutscene(dummy, feet, coins, trackX)

	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	local scale = character:GetScale()
	local dummyPos = dummy:GetPivot().Position

	-- lock the player in place facing the dummy
	root.Anchored = true
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, Vector3.new(dummyPos.X, root.Position.Y, dummyPos.Z))
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	local mid = (root.Position + dummyPos) / 2
	local shot = CFrame.lookAt(mid + Vector3.new(-2, 3 + 2 * scale, 14 + 4 * scale), mid)
	TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {CFrame = shot, FieldOfView = 60}):Play()

	-- wind up
	local joint, rot = shoulder(character)
	local baseC0 = joint and joint.C0
	if joint then
		animateJoint(joint, baseC0 * rot(math.rad(-60)), 0.45)
	end
	TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {FieldOfView = 52}):Play()
	task.wait(0.5)

	-- PUNCH
	playOneShot(WHOOSH_ID, 0.32, 1.15, 1)
	if joint then
		animateJoint(joint, baseC0 * rot(math.rad(95)), 0.08)
	end
	TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.5)}):Play()
	task.wait(0.08)

	-- impact freeze frame

	flash()
	local pow = bigText("POW!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 60), 0.28, 0.4)
	pow.Rotation = math.random(-12, 12)
	camera.FieldOfView = 40
	local shakeEnd = os.clock() + 0.4
	while os.clock() < shakeEnd do
		camera.CFrame = shot * CFrame.new(math.random(-10, 10) / 25, math.random(-10, 10) / 25, 0)
		task.wait()
	end
	fadeOut(pow, 0.1)
	if joint then
		animateJoint(joint, baseC0, 0.3)
	end

	-- chase cam
	camera.FieldOfView = 70
	local lastBiome = 0
	playOneShot(BOING_ID, 0.36, 1.05, 1.8)
	local ghost, cleanup = fly(dummy, feet, trackX, function(pos)
		local goal = CFrame.lookAt(pos + Vector3.new(-28, 12, 34), pos)
		camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(goal, 0.25)
		local index, name = PunchConfig.BiomeAt(pos.X)

			fadeOut(bigText(string.upper(name) .. "!", Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.1, 0.2), 0.6)
		end
	end)

	-- landing

	local reward = bigText("+" .. Format.Number(coins) .. " Coins", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 140), 0.09, 0.56)
	task.wait(1.6)
	fadeOut(banner, 0)
	fadeOut(reward, 0)
	cleanup()

	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	camera.FieldOfView = oldFov
	if root.Parent then
		root.Anchored = false
	end
	inCutscene = false
end

local C={}

local root
local loaded={}
local target=nil
local focus=7
local desired={}
local running=false
local journey=false
local generation=0
local function plan()
 local ids={}
 local function add(n) if n>=7 and not table.find(ids,n) then table.insert(ids,n) end end
 if target then add(target);add(target+1) end
 add(focus);add(focus+1);add(focus+2);add(focus-1);add(focus-2)
 while #ids>Punch.MaxExtraWorlds do table.remove(ids) end
 return ids
end
local function schedule()
 desired=plan();generation+=1
 if running then return end
 running=true
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,err=pcall(function()
   while true do
    local version=generation
    local want=desired
    for n,m in pairs(loaded) do if not table.find(want,n) then m:Destroy();loaded[n]=nil end end
    for _,n in ipairs(want) do
     if version~=generation then break end
     if not loaded[n] then loaded[n]=Builder.Build(root,n,{lod=true});task.wait() end
    end
    if generation==version then break end
   end
  end)
  running=false
  if not ok then warn("[TrackExtension] stream: "..tostring(err)) end
 end)
end
function C.Start()
 if started then return end;started=true
 root=Instance.new("Folder");root.Name="LocalTrackExtensions";root.Parent=workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Track")
 schedule()

 RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<.25 or journey then return end;elapsed=0
  local character=Players.LocalPlayer.Character
  local p=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

 target=math.max(7,(Punch.BiomeAt(x)))
 -- Destination is ready before the punch camera departs. It is never an empty sky.
 for _,n in ipairs({target,target+1}) do
  if not loaded[n] then
   local count=0;for _ in pairs(loaded) do count+=1 end
   if count>=Punch.MaxExtraWorlds then
    for old,m in pairs(loaded) do if old~=target and old~=target+1 then m:Destroy();loaded[old]=nil;break end end
   end
   loaded[n]=Builder.Build(root,n,{lod=true});task.wait()
  end
 end
 schedule()
end
function C.Focus(x)
 local stage=math.max(7,(Punch.BiomeAt(x)))
 if stage~=focus then focus=stage;schedule() end
end
function C.Release()
 journey=false;target=nil;focus=7;schedule()
end
function C.Audit()
 local ids={};local parts=0
 for n,m in pairs(loaded) do table.insert(ids,n);for _,p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then parts+=1 end end end

local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")

local EggVisual=require(RS.Shared.Util.EggVisual)
local Controller={}
local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="PetFollowers"
local followers,signatures,connections={},{},{}
local function clear(owner)
	for _,e in followers[owner] or {} do e.model:Destroy() end
	followers[owner]={}
end
local function rebuild(owner)
	local ok,inv=pcall(Http.JSONDecode,Http,owner:GetAttribute("PetInv") or "[]")
	local ids={}
	if ok and type(inv)=="table" then for _,e in inv do if e.e then table.insert(ids,e.p) end end end
	table.sort(ids)
	local signature=table.concat(ids,",")
	if signatures[owner]==signature then return end
	signatures[owner]=signature;clear(owner)
	for _,id in ids do
		local model=Visual.Make(id)
		local _,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
		local entry={model=model,size=size,fx={},ready=false}
		for _,x in model:GetDescendants() do if x:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then table.insert(entry.fx,x) end end
		model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId",owner.UserId)
		-- Start at the owner, never flash pets at world origin.
		local root=owner.Character and owner.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then model:PivotTo(root.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,8+size.Z))
		else model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,-1000,0)) end
		model.Parent=folder;table.insert(followers[owner],entry)
	end
	table.sort(followers[owner],function(a,b) return a.size.X<b.size.X end)
	-- A row holds three normal pets OR two giant pets. Width/depth follow actual geometry.
	local rows={};local row={};local giant=nil
	for _,e in followers[owner] do
		local big=e.model:GetAttribute("Massive")==true
		if #row>0 and (big~=giant or #row>=(if big then 2 else 3)) then table.insert(rows,row);row={} end
		giant=big;table.insert(row,e)
	end
	if #row>0 then table.insert(rows,row) end
	local back=5
	for _,r in rows do
		local width,depth=0,0
		for _,e in r do width+=e.size.X+1.3;depth=math.max(depth,e.size.Z) end
		local x=-width/2
		for _,e in r do
			e.offset=Vector3.new(x+e.size.X/2+.65,0,back+depth/2)
			x+=e.size.X+1.3
		end
		back+=depth+2
	end
end
local function track(owner)
	followers[owner]={};rebuild(owner)
	connections[owner]=owner:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PetInv"):Connect(function()rebuild(owner)end)
end
function Controller.Start()
	folder.Parent=workspace
	for _,owner in Players:GetPlayers() do track(owner) end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(track)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(owner)
		clear(owner);followers[owner]=nil;signatures[owner]=nil
		if connections[owner] then connections[owner]:Disconnect();connections[owner]=nil end
	end)
	local eggs={}
	local function addEgg(m) if m:IsA("Model") then eggs[m]=true end end
	for _,m in Tags:GetTagged("RemodeledEgg") do addEgg(m) end
	Tags:GetInstanceAddedSignal("RemodeledEgg"):Connect(addEgg)
	Tags:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("RemodeledEgg"):Connect(function(m) eggs[m]=nil end)
	local accumulator=0
	Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		accumulator+=dt;if accumulator<1/30 then return end
		local step=math.min(accumulator,.1);accumulator=0
		local t=os.clock();local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
		local eye=if camera then camera.CFrame.Position else Vector3.zero
		for owner,entries in followers do
			local root=owner.Character and owner.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			for i,e in entries do
				local visible=root and (root.Position-eye).Magnitude<180
				for _,fx in e.fx do fx.Enabled=visible==true end
				if root then
					local big=e.model:GetAttribute("Massive")
					local ground=root.Position.Y-root.Size.Y/2-(owner.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and owner.Character.Humanoid.HipHeight or 2)
					local xz=root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(e.offset)
					local y=ground+e.size.Y/2+.65+math.sin(t*(if big then 1.5 else 2.8)+i)*.22
					local goal=CFrame.new(xz.X,y,xz.Z)*root.CFrame.Rotation*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.sin(t*2+i)*.025)
					if visible then
						e.model:PivotTo(if e.ready then e.model:GetPivot():Lerp(goal,1-math.exp(-8*step)) else goal)
						e.ready=true;Visual.Animate(e.model,t+i)
					else e.model:PivotTo(goal);e.ready=false end
				elseif e.ready then
					e.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,-1000,0));e.ready=false
				end
			end
		end
		for m in eggs do if m.Parent then
			local visible=(m:GetPivot().Position-eye).Magnitude<150
			EggVisual.Animate(m,t,visible)
		else eggs[m]=nil end end
	end)
end
return Controller

local function fmt(n: number): string
	if n >= 1000 then
		return (string.format("%.1fk", n / 1000):gsub("%.0k$", "k"))
	end
	local s = string.format("%.2f", n):gsub("0+$", "")
	return (s:gsub("%.$", ""))
end

-- Pet model posed in a ViewportFrame, facing the camera
function PetsController.Viewport(petId: string, props: { [string]: any }?): ViewportFrame
	local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	vp.Name = "Viewport"
	vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	vp.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)
	for k, v in props or {} do
		(vp :: any)[k] = v
	end
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 40
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 6.2), Vector3.zero)
	camera.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = camera
	local ok, model = pcall(PetVisual.Make, petId, {Preview = true})
	if ok and model then
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0))
		model.Parent = vp
	end
	return vp
end

local function sortedInventory(inv: { any }): { any }
	local list = table.clone(inv)
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if (a.e == true) ~= (b.e == true) then
			return a.e == true
		end
		local pa = PetsConfig.List[a.p]
		local pb = PetsConfig.List[b.p]
		local powA = if pa then pa.Power else 0
		local powB = if pb then pb.Power else 0
		if powA ~= powB then
			return powA > powB
		end
		return tostring(a.u) < tostring(b.u)
	end)
	return list
end

local function render()
	if not grid or not info or not emptyLabel then
		return
	end
	dirty = false
	local inv, slots, mult = readState()
	for _, child in grid:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local equipped = 0
	for i, entry in sortedInventory(inv) do
		if entry.e then
			equipped += 1
		end
		makeCard(entry, i).Parent = grid
	end
	info.Text = string.format("Equipped %d/%d   Pets x%s   %d/%d", equipped, slots, fmt(mult), #inv, PetsConfig.MaxInventory)
	emptyLabel.Visible = #inv == 0
end

function PetsController.Start()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	local equipRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("EquipPet")
	local bestRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("EquipBest")
	onEquip = function(uid, equip)
		equipRemote:FireServer(uid, equip)
	end
	onEquipBest = function()
		bestRemote:FireServer()
	end
	readState = function()
		local inv = {}
		local raw = player:GetAttribute("PetInv")
		if type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
			local ok, decoded = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, raw)
			if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
				inv = decoded
			end
		end
		local slots = player:GetAttribute("PetSlots") or PetsConfig.BaseSlots
		local mult = player:GetAttribute("Mult_Pets")
		if type(mult) ~= "number" then
			local ids = {}
			for _, entry in inv do
				if entry.e then
					table.insert(ids, entry.p)
				end
			end
			mult = PetsConfig.Multiplier(ids)
		end
		return inv, slots, mult
	end
	build(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
	for _, name in { "PetInv", "PetSlots", "Mult_Pets" } do
		player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(markDirty)
	end
end

		end)

local function shake(frame: GuiObject, duration: number, strength: number)
	task.spawn(function()
		local base = frame.Position
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < duration and frame.Parent do
			local k = 1 - (os.clock() - t0) / duration
			frame.Position = base + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-strength, strength) * k, math.random(-strength, strength) * k)
			task.wait()
		end
		frame.Position = base
	end)
end

local function play(eggId: string, petIds: { string }, isAuto: boolean, hold: boolean?)
	local root = stage
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local scene = Instance.new("Frame")
	scene.Name = "Scene"
	scene.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scene.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	scene.Parent = root

	local center = Instance.new("Frame")
	center.Name = "Center"
	center.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	center.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	center.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	center.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(800, 600)
	center.ZIndex = 3
	center.Parent = scene
	scaled(center)

	-- 1. egg shakes harder and harder
	local shakeTime = if isAuto then 0.25 else 1.2
	local egg = eggViewport(eggId)
	egg.Parent = center
	local eggScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	eggScale.Scale = 0.6
	eggScale.Parent = egg
	tween(eggScale, 0.2, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < shakeTime do
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / shakeTime
		egg.Rotation = math.sin(os.clock() * (18 + k * 30)) * (4 + k * 22)
		eggScale.Scale = 1 + k * 0.15
		task.wait()
	end

	-- 2. white flash, egg cracks open
	local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
	flash.Name = "Flash"
	flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = C.White
	flash.ZIndex = 20
	flash.Parent = scene
	tween(flash, if isAuto then 0.2 else 0.45, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	egg:Destroy()

	-- 3. reveal pets (best rarity decides the extras)
	local best = 0
	local bestRarity = "Common"
	for _, id in petIds do
		local pet = PetsConfig.List[id]
		local r = pet and PetsConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity]
		if r and r.Order > best then
			best = r.Order
			bestRarity = pet.Rarity
		end
	end
	local count = math.min(#petIds, 3)
	for i = 1, count do
		petReveal(petIds[i], i, count, center, (i - 1) * (if isAuto then 0.03 else 0.12))
	end
	if bestRarity == "Legendary" or bestRarity == "Mythic" then
		rainbowBurst(scene, hold == true)
		local text = if bestRarity == "Mythic" then "MYTHIC!!" else "LEGENDARY!"
		banner(text, PetsConfig.Rarities[bestRarity].Color, center)
		shake(center, if isAuto then 0.3 else 0.6, if bestRarity == "Mythic" then 16 else 10)
	end
	if hold then
		return
	end

	-- 4. hold, then shrink away
	task.wait(if isAuto then 0.35 else 1.1)
	for _, child in center:GetChildren() do
		local s = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if s then
			tween(s, 0.2, { Scale = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
		end
	end
	task.wait(0.22)
	scene:Destroy()
end

local function pump()
	if playing then
		return

	playing = true

-- map a value from one range to another
local function map(x: number, inMin: number, inMax: number, outMin: number, outMax: number): number
	return (x - inMin)*(outMax - outMin)/(inMax - inMin) + outMin
end

local function getRelativeVelocity(cm, velocity)
	if not cm then
		return velocity
	end
	local activeSensor = cm.ActiveController and
	(
		(cm.ActiveController:IsA("GroundController") and cm.GroundSensor) or
		(cm.ActiveController:IsA("ClimbController") and cm.ClimbSensor)
	)
	if activeSensor and activeSensor.SensedPart then
		-- Calculate the platform relative velocity by subtracting the velocity of the surface we're attached to or standing on.
		local platformVelocity = activeSensor.SensedPart:GetVelocityAtPosition(cm.RootPart.Position)
		return velocity - platformVelocity
	end
	return velocity
end

local function playSound(sound: Playable, continue: boolean?)
	if not continue then
		(sound :: any).TimePosition = 0
	end
	if FFlagUserNewCharacterSoundsApi and sound:IsA("AudioPlayer") then
		sound:Play()
	else
		(sound :: Sound).Playing = true
	end
end

	end

local function shallowCopy(t)
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs(t) do
		out[k] = v
	end
	return out
end

local function initializeSoundSystem(instances: { [string]: Instance })
	local humanoid = instances.humanoid
	local rootPart = instances.rootPart
	local audioEmitter = nil
	local cm = nil
	if FFlagUserSoundsUseRelativeVelocity then
		local character = humanoid.Parent
		cm = character:FindFirstChild('ControllerManager')
	end

	local sounds: {[string]: Playable} = {}

	if FFlagUserNewCharacterSoundsApi and SoundService.CharacterSoundsUseNewApi == Enum.RolloutState.Enabled then
		-- initialize Audio Emitter
		local localPlayer = nil
		local character = nil
		local humanoidRootPart = nil
		if FFlagUserFixCharSoundsEmitters then
			humanoidRootPart = if FFlagUserFixCharSoundsEmitterRootPart then (humanoid.RootPart or humanoid.Parent) else humanoid.RootPart
		else
			localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
			character = localPlayer.Character
		end
		local curve = {}
		local i : number = 5
		local step : number = 1.25 -- determines how fine-grained the curve gets sampled
		while i < 150 do
			curve[i] = 5 / i;
			i *= step;
		end
		curve[150] = 0
		if FFlagUserFixCharSoundsEmitters then
			audioEmitter = Instance.new("AudioEmitter", humanoidRootPart)
		else
			audioEmitter = Instance.new("AudioEmitter", character)
		end
		audioEmitter.Name = "RbxCharacterSoundsEmitter"
		audioEmitter:SetDistanceAttenuation(curve)
		-- initialize sounds
		for name: string, props: {[string]: any} in pairs(AUDIOPLAYER_DATA) do
			local sound = Instance.new("AudioPlayer")
			local audioPlayerWire: Wire = Instance.new("Wire")
			sound.Name = name
			audioPlayerWire.Name = name .. "Wire"
			-- set default values
			sound.Archivable = false
			sound.Volume = 0.65
			for propName, propValue: any in pairs(props) do
				(sound :: any)[propName] = propValue
			end
			sound.Parent = rootPart
			audioPlayerWire.Parent = sound
			audioPlayerWire.SourceInstance = sound
			audioPlayerWire.TargetInstance = audioEmitter
			sounds[name] = sound
		end
	else
		-- initialize sounds
		for name: string, props: {[string]: any} in pairs(SOUND_DATA) do
			local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
			sound.Name = name
			-- set default values
			sound.Archivable = false
			sound.RollOffMinDistance = 5
			sound.RollOffMaxDistance = 150
			sound.Volume = 0.65
			for propName, propValue: any in pairs(props) do
				(sound :: any)[propName] = propValue
			end
			sound.Parent = rootPart
			sounds[name] = sound
		end
	end

	local playingLoopedSounds: {[Playable]: boolean?} = {}

	local function stopPlayingLoopedSounds(except: Playable?)
		except = except or nil --default value
		for sound in pairs(shallowCopy(playingLoopedSounds)) do
			if sound ~= except then
				stopSound(sound)
				playingLoopedSounds[sound] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	-- state transition callbacks.
	local stateTransitions: {[Enum.HumanoidStateType]: () -> ()} = {
		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			playSound(sounds.GettingUp)
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			playSound(sounds.Jumping)
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming] = function()
			local verticalSpeed = math.abs(rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)
			if verticalSpeed > 0.1 then
				(sounds.Splash :: any).Volume = math.clamp(map(verticalSpeed, 100, 350, 0.28, 1), 0, 1)
				playSound(sounds.Splash)
			end
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds(sounds.Swimming)
			playSound(sounds.Swimming, true)
			playingLoopedSounds[sounds.Swimming] = true
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall] = function()
			(sounds.FreeFalling :: any).Volume = 0
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds(sounds.FreeFalling)
			
			setSoundLooped(sounds.FreeFalling, true)
			if sounds.FreeFalling:IsA("Sound") then
				sounds.FreeFalling.PlaybackRegionsEnabled = true
			end
			(sounds.FreeFalling :: any).LoopRegion = NumberRange.new(2, 9)
			playSound(sounds.FreeFalling)
			
			playingLoopedSounds[sounds.FreeFalling] = true
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			local verticalSpeed = math.abs(rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)
			if verticalSpeed > 75 then
				(sounds.Landing :: any).Volume = math.clamp(map(verticalSpeed, 50, 100, 0, 1), 0, 1)
				playSound(sounds.Landing)
			end
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds(sounds.Running)
			playSound(sounds.Running, true)
			playingLoopedSounds[sounds.Running] = true
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing] = function()
			local sound = sounds.Climbing
			local partVelocity = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local velocity = if FFlagUserSoundsUseRelativeVelocity then getRelativeVelocity(cm, partVelocity) else partVelocity
			if math.abs(velocity.Y) > 0.1 then
				playSound(sound, true)
				stopPlayingLoopedSounds(sound)
			else
				stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			end
			playingLoopedSounds[sound] = true
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			playSound(sounds.Died)
		end,
	}

	-- updaters for looped sounds
	local loopedSoundUpdaters: {[Playable]: (number, Playable, Vector3) -> ()} = {
		[sounds.Climbing] = function(dt: number, sound: Playable, vel: Vector3)
			local velocity = if FFlagUserSoundsUseRelativeVelocity then getRelativeVelocity(cm, vel) else vel
			playSoundIf(sound, velocity.Magnitude > 0.1)
		end,

		[sounds.FreeFalling] = function(dt: number, sound: Playable, vel: Vector3): ()
			if vel.Magnitude > 75 then
				(sound :: any).Volume = math.clamp((sound :: any).Volume + 0.9*dt, 0, 1)
			else
				(sound :: any).Volume = 0
			end
		end,

		[sounds.Running] = function(dt: number, sound: Playable, vel: Vector3)
			playSoundIf(sound, vel.Magnitude > 0.5 and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.5)
		end,
	}

	-- state substitutions to avoid duplicating entries in the state table
	local stateRemap: {[Enum.HumanoidStateType]: Enum.HumanoidStateType} = {
		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics] = Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running,
	}

	local activeState: Enum.HumanoidStateType = stateRemap[humanoid:GetState()] or humanoid:GetState()

	local function transitionTo(state)
		local transitionFunc: () -> () = stateTransitions[state]

		if transitionFunc then
			transitionFunc()
		end

		activeState = state
	end

	transitionTo(activeState)

	local stateChangedConn = humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, state)
		state = stateRemap[state] or state

		if state ~= activeState then
			transitionTo(state)
		end
	end)

	local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, worldDt: number)
		-- update looped sounds on stepped
		for sound in pairs(playingLoopedSounds) do
			local updater: (number, Playable, Vector3) -> () = loopedSoundUpdaters[sound]

			if updater then
				updater(worldDt, sound, rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
			end
		end
	end)

	local function terminate()
		stateChangedConn:Disconnect()
		steppedConn:Disconnect()

		if FFlagUserFixCharSoundsEmitterRootPart and audioEmitter then
			audioEmitter:Destroy()
		end

		-- Unparent all sounds and empty sounds table
		-- This is needed in order to support the case where initializeSoundSystem might be called more than once for the same player,
		-- which might happen in case player character is unparented and parented back on server and reset-children mechanism is active.
		for name: string, sound: Playable in pairs(sounds) do
			sound:Destroy()
		end
		table.clear(sounds)
	end

	return terminate
end

local function isManifestResolved(resolvedManifest, manifestSizeTarget)
	local manifestSize = 0
	for _ in pairs(resolvedManifest) do

	end

	assert(manifestSize <= manifestSizeTarget, manifestSize)
	return manifestSize == manifestSizeTarget

local function unbindNodeDescend(node, resolvedManifest)
	if node.instance == nil then
		return -- Do not try to unbind nodes that are already unbound
	end

	node.instance = nil

	local connections = node.connections
	if connections then
		for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(connections)
	end

	if resolvedManifest and node.alias then
		resolvedManifest[node.alias] = nil
	end

	local children = node.children
	if children then
		for _, childNode in pairs(children) do
			unbindNodeDescend(childNode, resolvedManifest)
		end
	end
end

	local rootInstToRootNode = {} -- { [root] -> rootNode }
	local rootInstToManifest = {} -- { [root] -> { [alias] -> instance } }

	local parsedManifest = {} -- { [alias] = {Name, ...} }
	local manifestSizeTarget = 1 -- Add 1 because root isn't explicitly on the manifest	
	
	for alias, rawPath in pairs(manifest) do
		parsedManifest[alias] = parsePath(rawPath)
		manifestSizeTarget += 1
	end

	return setmetatable({
		_boundFn = boundFn,
		_parsedManifest = parsedManifest,
		_manifestSizeTarget = manifestSizeTarget,
		
		_dtorMap = dtorMap,
		_connections = connections,
		_rootInstToRootNode = rootInstToRootNode,
		_rootInstToManifest = rootInstToManifest,
	}, AtomicBinding)
end

function AtomicBinding:_startBoundFn(root, resolvedManifest)
	local boundFn = self._boundFn
	local dtorMap = self._dtorMap
	
	local oldDtor = dtorMap[root]
	if oldDtor then
		oldDtor()
		dtorMap[root] = nil
	end

	local dtor = boundFn(resolvedManifest)
	if dtor then
		dtorMap[root] = dtor
	end
end

function AtomicBinding:_stopBoundFn(root)
	local dtorMap = self._dtorMap
	
	local dtor = dtorMap[root]
	if dtor then
		dtor()
		dtorMap[root] = nil
	end
end

function AtomicBinding:bindRoot(root)
	debug.profilebegin("AtomicBinding:BindRoot")
	
	local parsedManifest = self._parsedManifest
	local rootInstToRootNode = self._rootInstToRootNode
	local rootInstToManifest = self._rootInstToManifest
	local manifestSizeTarget = self._manifestSizeTarget
	
	assert(rootInstToManifest[root] == nil)

	local resolvedManifest = {}
	rootInstToManifest[root] = resolvedManifest

	debug.profilebegin("BuildTree")

	local rootNode = {}
	rootNode.alias = ROOT_ALIAS
	rootNode.instance = root
	if next(parsedManifest) then
		-- No need to assign child data if there are no children
		rootNode.children = {}
		rootNode.connections = {}
	end

	rootInstToRootNode[root] = rootNode

	for alias, parsedPath in pairs(parsedManifest) do
		local parentNode = rootNode

		for idx, childName in ipairs(parsedPath) do
			local leaf = idx == #parsedPath
			local childNode = parentNode.children[childName] or {}

			if leaf then
				if childNode.alias ~= nil then
					error("Multiple aliases assigned to one instance")
				end

				childNode.alias = alias

			else
				childNode.children = childNode.children or {}
				childNode.connections = childNode.connections or {}
			end

			parentNode.children[childName] = childNode
			parentNode = childNode
		end
	end

	debug.profileend() -- BuildTree

	-- Recursively descend into the tree, resolving each node.
	-- Nodes start out as empty and instance-less; the resolving process discovers instances to map to nodes.
	local function processNode(node)
		local instance = assert(node.instance)

		local children = node.children
		local alias = node.alias
		local isLeaf = not children

		if alias then
			resolvedManifest[alias] = instance
		end

		if not isLeaf then
			local function processAddChild(childInstance)
				local childName = childInstance.Name
				local childNode = children[childName]
				if not childNode or childNode.instance ~= nil then
					return
				end

				childNode.instance = childInstance
				processNode(childNode)
			end

			local function processDeleteChild(childInstance)
				-- Instance deletion - Parent A detects that child B is being removed
				--    1. A removes B from `children`
				--    2. A traverses down from B,
				--       i.  Disconnecting inputs
				--       ii. Removing nodes from the resolved manifest
				--    3. stopBoundFn is called because we know the tree is no longer complete, or at least has to be refreshed
				-- 	  4. We search A for a replacement for B, and attempt to re-resolve using that replacement if it exists.
				-- To support the above sanely, processAddChild needs to avoid resolving nodes that are already resolved.

				local childName = childInstance.Name
				local childNode = children[childName]

				if not childNode then
					return -- There's no child node corresponding to the deleted instance, ignore
				end

				if childNode.instance ~= childInstance then
					return -- A child was removed with the same name as a node instance, ignore
				end

				self:_stopBoundFn(root) -- Happens before the tree is unbound so the manifest is still valid in the destructor.
				unbindNodeDescend(childNode, resolvedManifest) -- Unbind the tree

				assert(childNode.instance == nil) -- If this triggers, unbindNodeDescend failed

				-- Search for a replacement
				local replacementChild = instance:FindFirstChild(childName)
				if replacementChild then
					processAddChild(replacementChild)
				end
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				processAddChild(child)
			end

			table.insert(node.connections, instance.ChildAdded:Connect(processAddChild))
			table.insert(node.connections, instance.ChildRemoved:Connect(processDeleteChild))
		end

		if isLeaf and isManifestResolved(resolvedManifest, manifestSizeTarget) then
			self:_startBoundFn(root, resolvedManifest)
		end
	end

	debug.profilebegin("ResolveTree")
	processNode(rootNode)
	debug.profileend() -- ResolveTree
	
	debug.profileend() -- AtomicBinding:BindRoot
end

function AtomicBinding:unbindRoot(root)
	local rootInstToRootNode = self._rootInstToRootNode
	local rootInstToManifest = self._rootInstToManifest
	
	self:_stopBoundFn(root)

	local rootNode = rootInstToRootNode[root]
	if rootNode then
		local resolvedManifest = assert(rootInstToManifest[root])
		unbindNodeDescend(rootNode, resolvedManifest)
		rootInstToRootNode[root] = nil
	end

	rootInstToManifest[root] = nil
end

function AtomicBinding:destroy()
	debug.profilebegin("AtomicBinding:destroy")

	for _, dtor in pairs(self._dtorMap) do
		dtor:destroy()
	end
	table.clear(self._dtorMap)

	for _, conn in ipairs(self._connections) do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)

	local rootInstToManifest = self._rootInstToManifest
	for rootInst, rootNode in pairs(self._rootInstToRootNode) do
		local resolvedManifest = assert(rootInstToManifest[rootInst])
		unbindNodeDescend(rootNode, resolvedManifest)
	end
	table.clear(self._rootInstToManifest)
	table.clear(self._rootInstToRootNode)

	debug.profileend()
end

return AtomicBinding
